data.name: Avdhut
data.gender_notes: Avdhut is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Avdhut is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Avidya', which signifies ignorance or false knowledge. Avdhut is the one who has attained the supreme knowledge and is free from the bondage of Avidya. In Hindu mythology, Avdhut is an epithet of Lord Shiva, who is believed to have attained this state of enlightenment. The name Avdhut carries the meaning “Freedom from Avidya (ignorance)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avdhut usually hope their child will grow to embody freedom from avidya (ignorance) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wisdom, enlightenment, and liberation from ignorance.
data.etymology: Avdhut belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Freedom from Avidya (ignorance).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avdhut total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
